description: Dept. of Trade & Investment Policy - Regulations under the Customs Ordinance that disposal of Machinery & Equipment of Manufacturing & Exporting Apparel Businesses w.e.f. 15.03.2017 until further notice
reasoning: This gazette content promulgates regulations under the Customs Ordinance, specifically establishing rules for determining customs value for disposal of machinery and equipment imported under conditional duty exemption. It creates a regulatory framework with compliance requirements for enterprises in the apparel manufacturing and export business, falling squarely under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
